configuration.selection: greatest development full cross-modal score: .5*(O2S score+S2O score); no sealed access
configuration.full_sampling: 4 gated +4 other distinct identities per update, uniform within strata; foundation and full arm
configuration.comparison: Same selected fresh foundation, initialization, optimizers and maximum update/compute budget; target-domain exposure differs (8 vs4 per step), explicit training regime comparison not isolated identity-count causality
configuration.primary_gate: full arm minus specialist: sealed full cross-modal >=.03, joint >=.01, extra pairing >=0, source pairing >=-.005; then repeat both arms with a second seed before deployment

initialization: Reviewed scene-pair pretraining only, random classifier/global/local heads, no old identity-trained checkpoint or old pair head
sealed_policy: Training decodes train/development only. Both arms select and finish on development before one final sealed evaluation. No changes based on sealed outcome
limitation: New holdout for fresh supervision/selection, not a newly acquired dataset; labelled corpus was previously studied. Author pretraining provenance not independently audited; no claim of absolute unseen source
